title: Requirement Document
content:
# Requirement Document: Build a full-stack e-commerce platform that allows users to register, browse products, manage a shopping cart, place orders, make payments, track order status, and manage returns, with an admin dashboard for product, inventory, and order management.



## Objectives
Automate workflows
Improve user experience
Provide data insights
